moments.title: The Hundred Continues This Weekend
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament is in full swing across the UK, with matches scheduled today and tomorrow in Leeds, Cardiff, Manchester, and Nottingham.

angles.name: Today's Matches
angles.copy: It's Day 5 of The Hundred! Today sees Sunrisers Leeds take on Southern Brave at Headingley, while Welsh Fire host MI London at Sophia Gardens. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: Go, Welsh Fire! Our local heroes are in action today at Sophia Gardens against MI London. Catch all the excitement from the Hundred!

angles.name: Weekend Cricket
angles.copy: The Hundred weekend is here! Catch more action tomorrow with Manchester Super Giants vs Birmingham Phoenix at Old Trafford and Trent Rockets vs London Spirit at Trent Bridge. Big hits incoming!

moments.title: Commonwealth Games 2026 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Commonwealth Games 2026 begins today, July 25th, with live coverage on Channel 5, bringing two days of exciting competition.

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games are officially underway! Tune into Channel 5 today and tomorrow for all the action from Day 1 and Day 2. Who are you cheering for?

angles.name: Weekend Sporting Action
angles.copy: Beyond the cricket, the Commonwealth Games are here! Day 1 and 2 are packed with events – perfect for your weekend sports fix.

moments.title: Together Again Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: The family-friendly Together Again Festival at Bolesworth Castle, Cheshire, concludes today after a weekend of music and entertainment.

angles.name: Festival Finale
angles.copy: Last chance to catch the fun at Together Again Festival! It's the final day at Bolesworth Castle – hope everyone had an amazing weekend!

angles.name: Cheshire Festival
angles.copy: Bolesworth Castle has been buzzing all weekend! Together Again Festival wraps up today. Who made it down for the music and family fun?

moments.title: Truck Festival Finishes Today
moments.blurb: Oxfordshire's Truck Festival, known for its indie spirit, concludes its 2026 edition today after a weekend of live music.

angles.name: Truck Festival Last Day
angles.copy: That's a wrap for Truck Festival 2026! Hope everyone in Oxfordshire and beyond had an incredible time. What were your highlights?

angles.name: Indie Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The indie anthems are fading out as Truck Festival 2026 comes to a close. Shout out to all the rock and indie fans who descended on Oxfordshire!

moments.title: Latitude Festival Ends Today
moments.blurb: Latitude Festival, held at Henham Park in Suffolk, concludes its eclectic mix of music, arts, and comedy today.

angles.name: Latitude Closing
angles.copy: Another amazing Latitude Festival draws to a close today in Suffolk. What was your favourite moment from this year's event?

angles.name: Suffolk Festival
angles.copy: Henham Park is emptying out as Latitude 2026 concludes! We hope all our Suffolk listeners who attended had a fantastic time.

moments.title: Love Island UK Finale Airs Monday
moments.blurb: The grand finale of Love Island UK Season 13 will be broadcast live on Monday, July 27th, at 9pm on ITV2 and ITVX.

angles.name: Final Countdown
angles.copy: The Love Island 2026 final is just two days away! Who do you think will be crowned the winning couple on Monday night?

angles.name: Monday Night TV
angles.copy: Clear your Monday night plans! The Love Island UK finale hits ITV2 at 9pm. Get ready for the drama and declaration of love!

moments.title: New TV Premieres Tonight
moments.blurb: Tonight, BBC One launches a new series of 'The Hit List' at 5:55pm, while ITV1 premieres 'Celebrity Deal Or No Deal' at 7pm.

angles.name: Saturday Night In
angles.copy: Stay in tonight? New series alert! Catch 'The Hit List' on BBC One at 5:55pm, followed by 'Celebrity Deal Or No Deal' on ITV1 at 7pm.

angles.name: Game Show Double
angles.copy: Your Saturday night is sorted with new game shows! 'The Hit List' on BBC One and 'Celebrity Deal Or No Deal' on ITV1. Who's watching?

moments.title: UK Weather: Mixed Outlook for Next Week
moments.blurb: The UK is set for a mixed bag of weather in the coming days, with rain mainly in the north this weekend, and temperatures creeping back up in the south next week, while northern areas remain cloudier and cooler.

angles.name: Weekend Weather
angles.copy: Patchy rain for the north, hot and sunny for the south! That's your UK weather outlook for the weekend. Make the most of it!

angles.name: Next Week's Forecast
angles.copy: Looking ahead, temperatures are set to rise again in the south next week, but the north can expect more cloud and showers. Don't forget your brollies!

moments.title: Mick Jagger Turns 83
moments.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday tomorrow, July 26th. He was born in 1943.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, a true rock 'n' roll legend turns 83! Happy early birthday to Sir Mick Jagger of The Rolling Stones. Still got the moves!

angles.name: Stones Forever
angles.copy: Can you believe Mick Jagger will be 83 tomorrow?! From the 60s to now, The Rolling Stones frontman is still an absolute icon. Play your favourite Stones track loud!

moments.title: Kate Bush Celebrates 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Influential British singer-songwriter Kate Bush will turn 68 on July 30th. She was born in 1958.

angles.name: Kate Bush Day
angles.copy: Running up that hill to wish an early happy 68th birthday to the incredible Kate Bush on July 30th! An artist like no other.

angles.name: Iconic Songwriter
angles.copy: From 'Wuthering Heights' to 'Running Up That Hill', Kate Bush has consistently pushed boundaries. She celebrates her 68th birthday next week!

moments.title: Fatboy Slim Turns 63
moments.blurb: Norman Cook, better known as DJ Fatboy Slim, celebrates his 63rd birthday on July 31st. He was born in 1963.

angles.name: Big Beat Birthday
angles.copy: Praise You! The one and only Fatboy Slim (Norman Cook) turns 63 next Friday! Get ready to drop some big beat classics.

angles.name: Dance Floor Filler
angles.copy: Still filling dance floors worldwide! Happy almost-birthday to Fatboy Slim, celebrating 63 years of beats next week. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: Scotland's Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival, featuring James, The Human League, and Callum Beattie, runs from July 30th to August 1st in the Scottish Highlands.

angles.name: Highlands Festival
angles.copy: The Highlands are calling! Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival kicks off next Thursday with James, The Human League and more. Who's heading to Bella?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just days until Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival! Get ready for a fantastic lineup in the Scottish Highlands from July 30th.

moments.title: Y-Not Festival Kicks Off Next Week
moments.blurb: Derbyshire's Y-Not Festival, featuring The Libertines, Reytons, Two Door Cinema Club, and The Streets, takes place from July 30th to August 2nd.

angles.name: Derbyshire Rocks
angles.copy: Y-Not Festival is almost here! Derbyshire is set for a huge weekend of music from July 30th with The Libertines, The Streets and more. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: Rock and indie fans, assemble! Y-Not Festival brings The Libertines, Reytons, and Two Door Cinema Club to Derbyshire next week. Get ready to mosh!

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset Next Week
moments.blurb: Camp Bestival Dorset, a family-friendly festival at Lulworth Castle, runs from July 30th to August 2nd with headliners including Bastille, Fatboy Slim, and Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Family Festival Fun
angles.copy: Next week, it's Camp Bestival Dorset! Get ready for family fun at Lulworth Castle with Bastille, Fatboy Slim, and Billy Ocean from July 30th.

angles.name: Dorset Excitement
angles.copy: Lulworth Castle is gearing up for Camp Bestival next week! Who's heading to Dorset for the ultimate family festival experience?

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Starts Next Week
moments.blurb: A new festival series, Palace Bowl Presents, kicks off at the Crystal Palace Bowl in London from July 31st to August 16th, featuring an eclectic lineup.

angles.name: London Festival
angles.copy: New festival alert! Palace Bowl Presents launches next Friday at Crystal Palace Bowl. Get ready for an eclectic lineup in the heart of London!

angles.name: Summer in the City
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is set to host a brand new festival series, Palace Bowl Presents, starting next Friday! Three weeks of music await.

moments.title: Summer Nights at the Bandstand Returns
moments.blurb: Summer Nights at the Bandstand returns to Kelvingrove Park, Glasgow, for its eleventh year, with events running from July 27th to August 15th.

angles.name: Glasgow Summer Gigs
angles.copy: Summer Nights at the Bandstand is back in Glasgow! Kelvingrove Park will host a series of gigs from Monday. Who are you hoping to see?

angles.name: Outdoor Concerts
angles.copy: Get ready for some fantastic outdoor music! Summer Nights at the Bandstand returns to Glasgow's Kelvingrove Park this Monday.

moments.title: GuilFest Returns This July
moments.blurb: GuilFest, featuring Sophie Ellis-Bextor, Rudimental (DJ set), and The Lottery Winners, has returned to Stoke Park, Guildford, for a two-day music and arts weekend this July.

angles.name: Guildford Festival
angles.copy: GuilFest is back in Stoke Park this July! If you're heading to Guildford this weekend, expect Sophie Ellis-Bextor, Rudimental and more!

angles.name: Festival Flashback
angles.copy: From Sophie Ellis-Bextor to ABC, GuilFest has a lineup spanning the decades this July. Who remembers their first time at GuilFest?
